purpose_context: Felix's own observability currently spends money by using LLMs where plain deterministic checks would do: a Haiku call gates every 30-minute heartbeat, and the twice-daily health-check is routed through the Sonnet main agent. This mission moves both onto deterministic, no-LLM-in-the-hot-path execution while preserving cadence, escalation-to-Sonnet, the ledger, and the fail-safe. It is the Sprint-0 quick win of the Felix Bedrock Stabilization program (epic #673, Foundation 1), applying the deterministic-canary principle ahead of the full F1 build (#516).
purpose_tldr: Replace Felix's two LLM-mediated self-monitoring paths with deterministic checks, cutting ~$15-20/mo of avoidable spend while preserving escalation and fail-safe behavior.
